description: Mitigations for electrical contact and arc flash. Covers isolation (LOTO), insulation, PPE, and detection.

mitigations.name: low_voltage_design
mitigations.description: Design the system to operate below 50V AC (IEC 60479 safety threshold). SELV/PELV systems. Eliminates the hazard by keeping voltage below dangerous levels.
mitigations.pfd_source: Inherent safety — the system cannot produce dangerous voltage by design.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Below 50V, current through intact skin is below perception threshold. Near-complete elimination of electrical injury risk.

mitigations.name: loto
mitigations.description: Physical isolation of energy source with personal lock. 29 CFR 1910.147. Requires worker to apply lock — human-dependent step, but once locked the isolation is physical.
mitigations.pfd_source: LOPA: PFD 0.05 for LOTO. Failure modes: not applied (most common — time pressure, complacency), wrong isolation point, stored energy not dissipated, lock removed prematurely. OSHA: LOTO violations are #4 most cited standard.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: When correctly applied, system is de-energised. Near-complete elimination of contact risk. Stored energy (capacitors, springs) is the residual hazard if not verified.

mitigations.name: insulated_tools_gloves
mitigations.description: Voltage-rated insulated gloves (EN 60903) and insulated tools for live work. Prevents current path through body. Requires correct voltage class selection and regular testing.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.10 for PPE. Failure modes: wrong voltage class, gloves not tested (6-month retest required), pinhole damage, not worn for 'quick job'.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: When correctly rated and intact, insulated gloves prevent current flow. EN 60903 proof-tested to voltage class. Effectiveness limited by glove integrity and correct selection.

mitigations.name: arc_rated_ppe
mitigations.description: Arc-rated clothing, face shield, gloves per NFPA 70E PPE categories. Protects against arc flash thermal energy. Category 1 (4 cal/cm2) to Category 4 (40 cal/cm2).
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.10 for PPE. Failure modes: wrong category for incident energy, not worn, clothing damaged, face shield not down.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: NFPA 70E PPE category testing — clothing prevents burns up to rated incident energy. Arc blast pressure and shrapnel are not fully mitigated by clothing.

mitigations.name: gfci_rcd
mitigations.description: Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter / Residual Current Device. Trips at 30mA in <30ms — below VF threshold for most pathways. Automatic, no human action required.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.02. Passive engineered device. Failure modes: not installed (older circuits), tripped/bypassed, failed to trip (stuck contacts — requires monthly test).
mitigations.effectiveness_source: IEC 60479: 30mA RCD limits current below VF threshold for most exposure durations. Very effective for domestic/light industrial voltages. Less effective for high-energy arc flash.

mitigations.name: permit_to_work_elec
mitigations.description: Formal authorisation for electrical work by competent person. Ensures LOTO, proving dead, correct PPE, and safe system of work. Administrative control.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: Effectiveness is indirect — ensures other controls (LOTO, PPE) are in place. A permit alone doesn't prevent shock.

mitigations.name: emergency_response
mitigations.description: Trained first aiders with AED, emergency isolation procedure, burn treatment capability. Post-contact response. AED within 3 minutes dramatically improves cardiac arrest survival.
mitigations.pfd_source: PFD 0.20. Requires trained personnel on site, AED maintained and accessible, prompt response.
mitigations.effectiveness_source: AED within 3 min: ~70% survival from VF cardiac arrest. Without AED: ~5% survival. Effectiveness is dominated by response time.
